purpose: Prove that Council Semantic Contract terms and edge types project into Microsoft knowledge planes (Dataverse semantic model, Fabric IQ ontology) as projections only: the Council Semantic Contract remains the single canonical source; planes never become authoring surfaces. Local contract evidence only — every would-be live plane write is deferred and receipt-gated; one deliberately drifted plane representation is flagged for reconciliation without any in-place plane edit.

projectionManifest.projectedRepresentation: Dataverse relationship display name 'Proposed From' (Work Item → Source Record); glossary binding proposed_from
Dataverse relationship display name 'Evidenced By' (Receipt/Work Item → Source Record); glossary binding evidenced_by
Fabric IQ relationship type assigned_to (Work Item → Person/Role); ontology edge label Assigned To
Fabric IQ entity type decision; ontology entity label Decision (graph node, not a Work Item execution shell)
Fabric IQ relationship type proposed_from (Work Item → Source Record); ontology edge label Proposed From
Dataverse choice value meeting_action on com_workitemtype; semantic model glossary entry Meeting Action

driftDetection.canonicalProjectedRepresentation: Fabric IQ relationship type proposed_from (Work Item → Source Record); ontology edge label Proposed From
driftDetection.observedPlaneRepresentation: Fabric IQ relationship type proposedFromSource (inferred alias processes Work Item to Source); ontology edge label Sourced Proposal — platform-inferred rename NOT approved in the Council Semantic Contract
driftDetection.detectionRationale: Fabric IQ ontology surface shows a renamed edge label for the same binding that Council projects as proposed_from. The plane is not authoritative; this slice records the drift detection and flags reconciliation back to the Council Semantic Contract. The plane representation is never edited in place; a reconciliation Work Item / contract update path is the only allowed remediation and stays receipt-gated.

receipts.com_policy_flags: local_contract_evidence_only; no_tenant_write; no_outbound_action; planes_are_projections_only; drift_never_edits_plane_in_place; reconciliation_flagged

receipts.com_decision_rationale: Reconciliation is receipt-backed. Platform-inferred terms may only propose contract updates; they must surface as a Source Record, Work Item, or Memory Candidate path and never silently update canonical Council meaning.
